name: Beijing
description: Beijing, the capital of China, is a city where ancient history meets modern development. With over 3,000 years of history, it's home to some of China's most iconic landmarks.
chineseDescription: 北京是中国的首都，是一座古老历史与现代发展交融的城市。拥有3000多年历史，是中国最具标志性地标的所在地。

attractions.name: The Great Wall
attractions.description: One of the Seven Wonders of the World, the Great Wall stretches over 13,000 miles. The Badaling and Mutianyu sections near Beijing are most popular.
attractions.tips: Visit early morning to avoid crowds. Wear comfortable shoes.

attractions.name: Forbidden City
attractions.description: The imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties, featuring 980 buildings with traditional Chinese architecture.
attractions.tips: Book tickets online in advance. Allow 3-4 hours for visit.

attractions.name: Temple of Heaven
attractions.description: A masterpiece of Ming architecture where emperors performed annual ceremonies to pray for good harvests.
attractions.tips: Visit in early morning to see locals practicing tai chi.

attractions.name: Summer Palace
attractions.description: A vast imperial garden with beautiful lakes, pavilions, and the famous Marble Boat.
attractions.tips: Rent a boat on Kunming Lake for a unique perspective.

name: Shanghai
description: Shanghai is China's largest city and financial hub, known for its stunning skyline, colonial architecture, and vibrant culture.
chineseDescription: 上海是中国最大的城市和金融中心，以其壮观的天际线、殖民建筑和充满活力的文化而闻名。

attractions.name: The Bund
attractions.description: A waterfront area featuring colonial-era buildings and stunning views of modern Pudong skyline across the river.
attractions.tips: Visit at night for spectacular light shows.

attractions.name: Yu Garden
attractions.description: A classical Chinese garden from the Ming Dynasty with beautiful pavilions, ponds, and rockeries.
attractions.tips: Visit on weekdays to avoid weekend crowds.

attractions.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
attractions.description: An iconic TV tower with observation decks offering panoramic city views.
attractions.tips: Book tickets online for faster entry.

attractions.name: Nanjing Road
attractions.description: One of the world's busiest shopping streets, stretching from the Bund to Jing'an Temple.
attractions.tips: Walk the pedestrian section for the best experience.

name: Xi'an
description: Xi'an, one of China's ancient capitals, was the starting point of the Silk Road and home to the famous Terracotta Warriors.
chineseDescription: 西安是中国古都之一，是丝绸之路的起点，也是著名兵马俑的所在地。

attractions.name: Terracotta Warriors
attractions.description: An archaeological marvel featuring thousands of life-sized terracotta soldiers buried with Emperor Qin Shi Huang.
attractions.tips: Hire a guide to fully appreciate the history. Allow 3-4 hours.

attractions.name: Ancient City Wall
attractions.description: One of the best-preserved city walls in China, offering bike rentals for a unique tour experience.
attractions.tips: Rent a bike and cycle the 14km perimeter at sunset.

attractions.name: Muslim Quarter
attractions.description: A vibrant area with Islamic architecture, street food, and traditional crafts.
attractions.tips: Try local specialties like roujiamo and yangrou paomo.

attractions.name: Big Wild Goose Pagoda
attractions.description: A Buddhist pagoda built in 652 AD, housing sacred Buddhist texts brought from India.
attractions.tips: Visit the musical fountain show in the evening.

name: Chengdu
description: Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province, is famous for its spicy cuisine, laid-back lifestyle, and giant pandas.
chineseDescription: 成都是四川省会，以其麻辣美食、悠闲生活方式和大熊猫而闻名。

attractions.name: Giant Panda Base
attractions.description: A conservation center where you can see giant pandas in a natural habitat setting.
attractions.tips: Visit in the morning (8-10am) when pandas are most active.

attractions.name: Jinli Ancient Street
attractions.description: A reconstructed ancient street with traditional architecture, shops, and street food.
attractions.tips: Visit in the evening for beautiful lantern lighting.

attractions.name: Wuhou Shrine
attractions.description: A temple dedicated to Zhuge Liang, the famous strategist of the Three Kingdoms period.
attractions.tips: Combine with a visit to nearby Jinli Street.

attractions.name: People's Park
attractions.description: A popular park where locals gather for tea, mahjong, and traditional ear cleaning.

name: Guilin
description: Guilin is renowned for its stunning karst landscape, with limestone peaks rising dramatically from the Li River.
chineseDescription: 桂林以其壮丽的喀斯特地貌而闻名，石灰岩山峰从漓江中拔地而起。

attractions.name: Li River Cruise
attractions.description: A scenic cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo, passing through breathtaking karst mountains.
attractions.tips: Book a morning cruise for the best light and fewer crowds.

attractions.name: Reed Flute Cave
attractions.description: A spectacular limestone cave with colorful lighting illuminating natural rock formations.
attractions.tips: Join a guided tour to learn about the formations.

attractions.name: Elephant Trunk Hill
attractions.description: Guilin's symbol, a hill shaped like an elephant drinking from the river.
attractions.tips: Best photographed from across the river.

attractions.name: Longji Rice Terraces
attractions.description: Spectacular terraced rice fields carved into mountain slopes over 700 years ago.
attractions.tips: Visit in May-June (water-filled) or September-October (golden harvest).

name: Hangzhou
description: Hangzhou, the capital of Zhejiang Province, is famous for its scenic West Lake, historic temples, and as the birthplace of Longjing tea.
chineseDescription: 杭州是浙江省会，以风景秀丽的西湖、历史悠久的寺庙和龙井茶的故乡而闻名。

attractions.name: West Lake
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site with beautiful gardens, pagodas, and causeways. Famous for its 'Ten Scenes of West Lake'.
attractions.tips: Rent a bike to explore the lake perimeter. Visit at sunset for stunning views.

attractions.name: Lingyin Temple
attractions.description: One of China's largest and wealthiest Buddhist temples, founded in 328 AD, nestled in lush forest.
attractions.tips: Visit early morning to experience morning prayers and avoid crowds.

attractions.name: Longjing Tea Plantations
attractions.description: Terraced tea plantations producing China's most famous green tea. Visitors can pick tea and learn about tea culture.
attractions.tips: Visit in spring (March-April) during harvest season for the best experience.

attractions.name: Hefang Street
attractions.description: A historic pedestrian street with traditional architecture, local snacks, and handicraft shops.
attractions.tips: Try traditional Hangzhou snacks like osmanthus cake and beggar's chicken.

name: Suzhou
description: Known as the 'Venice of the East', Suzhou is famous for its classical gardens, silk production, and ancient water towns.
chineseDescription: 苏州被称为'东方威尼斯'，以其古典园林、丝绸生产和古老水乡而闻名。

attractions.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
attractions.description: The largest and most famous classical garden in Suzhou, a UNESCO World Heritage site with ponds, pavilions, and rockeries.
attractions.tips: Visit on weekdays to avoid crowds. Allow 2-3 hours to fully explore.

attractions.name: Pingjiang Road
attractions.description: A historic canal street with traditional architecture, teahouses, and boutique shops along the waterway.
attractions.tips: Visit in the evening when lanterns are lit for a romantic atmosphere.

attractions.name: Tiger Hill
attractions.description: A historic site with the famous leaning Yunyan Pagoda, known as the 'Leaning Tower of China'.
attractions.tips: Climb to the top for panoramic views of Suzhou.

attractions.name: Tongli Water Town
attractions.description: An ancient water town with well-preserved Ming and Qing architecture, stone bridges, and canals.
attractions.tips: Take a boat ride through the canals for the best experience.

name: Lijiang
description: Lijiang is a UNESCO World Heritage ancient town in Yunnan Province, known for its well-preserved old town and Naxi minority culture.
chineseDescription: 丽江是云南省的联合国教科文组织世界遗产古城，以保存完好的古城和纳西族文化而闻名。

attractions.name: Lijiang Old Town
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site with cobblestone streets, traditional Naxi architecture, and flowing canals.
attractions.tips: Explore early morning or evening to avoid crowds. Get lost in the maze of alleys.

attractions.name: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
attractions.description: A stunning mountain range with glaciers, reaching 5,596 meters. Cable cars take visitors to high altitudes.
attractions.tips: Bring warm clothes and be prepared for altitude. Book tickets in advance.

attractions.name: Blue Moon Valley
attractions.description: A scenic valley at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain with turquoise lakes and waterfalls.
attractions.tips: Visit on sunny days when the water is most vibrant blue.

attractions.name: Shuhe Ancient Town
attractions.description: A quieter alternative to Lijiang Old Town, with similar architecture but fewer tourists.
attractions.tips: Stay overnight to experience the peaceful atmosphere after day-trippers leave.

name: Nanjing
description: Nanjing served as China's capital for six dynasties. Rich in history with beautiful lakes and mountains.
chineseDescription: 南京曾是六朝古都，历史悠久，山水秀美。

attractions.name: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum
attractions.description: Grand mausoleum honoring Dr. Sun Yat-sen on Purple Mountain.

attractions.name: Confucius Temple
attractions.description: Temple complex along Qinhuai River with markets.

attractions.name: Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum
attractions.description: Tomb of Hongwu Emperor, UNESCO site.

attractions.name: Nanjing City Wall
attractions.description: World's longest city wall from Ming Dynasty.

attractions.name: Xuanwu Lake
attractions.description: Scenic lake park with islands and gardens.

name: Shenzhen
description: China's tech hub, transformed from fishing village in 40 years.
chineseDescription: 中国科技中心，40年从渔村崛起。

attractions.name: Window of the World
attractions.description: Theme park with miniature world landmarks.

attractions.name: Splendid China
attractions.description: China's ethnic diversity and landmarks in miniature.

name: Guangzhou
description: Birthplace of Cantonese cuisine, major trading port with 2,000 years history.
chineseDescription: 粤菜发源地，2000年历史贸易港。

attractions.name: Canton Tower
attractions.description: China's tallest tower with world's highest Ferris wheel.

attractions.name: Beijing Road
attractions.description: Shopping street with ancient road remains.

name: Tianjin
description: Port city near Beijing, known for colonial architecture and street food.
chineseDescription: 北京附近港口城市，以殖民建筑和街头小吃闻名。

name: Chongqing
description: Mountain city famous for hotpot and Yangtze River.
chineseDescription: 山城，以火锅和长江闻名。

name: Wuhan
description: Central China hub where Yangtze and Han rivers meet.
chineseDescription: 华中枢纽，长江汉江交汇处。

name: Dalian
description: Coastal city with beaches and Russian architecture.
chineseDescription: 海滨城市，有海滩和俄式建筑。

name: Qingdao
description: Beer city with German colonial heritage and beaches.
chineseDescription: 啤酒之城，德式殖民遗产和海滩。

name: Xiamen
description: Coastal city with Gulangyu Island and colonial architecture.
chineseDescription: 海滨城市，有鼓浪屿和殖民建筑。

name: Harbin
description: Ice city with Russian influence and winter festival.
chineseDescription: 冰城，俄罗斯风情和冰雪节。

name: Kunming
description: Spring City with eternal spring weather and Stone Forest.
chineseDescription: 春城，四季如春，有石林。

name: Lhasa
description: Tibet's spiritual capital with Potala Palace at high altitude.
chineseDescription: 西藏精神首都，有布达拉宫，高海拔。
